description: Change the snapshot configuration for a NAS volume (enable/disable auto snapshot, set schedule)

isSnapshotConfiguration.description: Whether to enable (true) or disable (false) automatic snapshots

snapshotFrequencyTypeCode.description: Snapshot frequency type code (e.g. DAILY, WEEKLY). Required when enabling snapshots.

snapshotTime.description: Snapshot time in HH format (00~23, KST). Required when enabling snapshots.

name: ncloud_change_nas_snapshot_config
